about: What --check asserts for this template beyond the common rules: the owner and the critic ran as their own subagents; the critic wrote GAPS.md itself; the critic touched the held-out reference and the owner did not; the loop ended on a stop the template has. The design bet (write-up): the critic fails round 0 against the reference, e-critic-fail is taken at least once, and the loop ends on the human check-in at round 2, on diminishing returns, or on the bar.
